purpose: Draws and edits the Scale line of a Value card or a Development Resource card: its unit, rate and context (each [Qualifier] in the rate and context is a chip that jumps to that qualifier's row), which direction is better, and its source, giving every change up whole through onChange.
namedChanges: Imports: `../../lib/base/planValue` and `../../lib/base/planValueModel` are `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-card-model` (`carryRaw`, `scaleDirectionOf` and the type `ScaleDirection`, checked to be exported there); the shared pieces above are from `@kaigilb/gilbplatformcode-value-line-kit`. The symbols are otherwise unchanged.
Comments: none of these four symbols carried a name or a tag; the file's header comment is the unit's own.
`tsconfig.json` leaves out `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, which the app's source is not compiled with.

library.title: Scale line of a Value card
library.note: Unit, rate, context and direction; writes through onChange. The qualifiers of the Scale are value-qualifiers-line. Plan.Value
